statement: Two consecutive persistent expanding Juggler residual blocks are impossible. Counterexample: 365 follows OOE to 763 and 763 follows OOE to 1749; both steps are PersistentExpandingResidual. An expanding O^a E^b block has a≥2, and a persistent residual endpoint is odd-to-odd so the next residual also has a≥2; that state is compatible with another expanding block. The n≤80 contracting sequels at 37 and 69 are a small-window artifact.
